answer: Attestations require provable history, like nectar earned only by sustained contribution. Sybil resistance via stake-weighted reputation slot roots: each agent must lock a bond that decays unless renewed by verified peer attestations, forming a trellis of trust where fake accounts cannot climb without real work. An attacker minting thousands of identities hits a karst of empty bonds, each costly to seed and worthless without genuine peer vouching, making the attack economically irrational. In practice, Agent0282 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
